summary.zh-Hans: 清水寺本堂前伸出的木造舞台由高大的木柱支撑，可眺望京都。清水寺是“古京都历史古迹”的组成部分。
summary.en: A wooden stage supported by tall pillars projects from Kiyomizu-dera’s Main Hall and overlooks Kyoto. The temple is part of the Historic Monuments of Ancient Kyoto World Heritage property.

summary.zh-Hans: 二条城的二之丸御殿由六栋相连的建筑组成。人走过廊道时，地板会因金属连接件与钉子摩擦而发出类似鸟鸣的声音。
summary.en: Nijo-jo’s Ninomaru Palace consists of six connected buildings. Its corridor floor chirps as metal clamps rub against nails when people walk over it.

summary.zh-Hans: 汤豆腐将豆腐放在热汤中温煮，再蘸调味汁食用，是京都有代表性的豆腐料理。
summary.en: Yudofu is a Kyoto tofu dish served warm from a simmering pot, with a dipping sauce alongside.

summary.zh-Hans: 汤叶是加热豆浆时表面形成的薄膜，是京都料理中常见的食材，可以鲜食或加入锅物。
summary.en: Yuba is the thin skin that forms on heated soy milk. Used in Kyoto cuisine, it can be eaten fresh or added to hot pots.
